## CHR-1257 — App UI refresh (design only)

Job from Christian (phone call 2026-11-26, 11:22 CET, passed on by Assi). Design only: no product code, no PR. Correction 11:38 CET (via Assi): the second reference is doop.design, not dupe.design.

**Problem:** the chrome (2.2.1) feels boxy, angular and dated. Screens, Context and Elements panels are fixed columns (264 + 252 + 280 px), so at 1440 px the open screen gets about 430 px. Update toast and variant tree overlay the canvas on top of that. Reference: `renders/current-2.2.1-screens.png`.

**Requirements:** (a) pleasing to the eye, (b) the screen gets the most space, (c) tools easy to reach, (d) hide what is not needed or never show it.

**Directions** (mockup `ui-refresh`, PNGs in `mockups/ui-refresh/renders/`):
1. `1-stitch` — floating, draggable, foldable cards on a dotted canvas; tools above the selected frame. Source: Google Stitch canvas redesign, blog.google (2026-03-18, 2026-05-19).
2. `2-doop` — Doop layout: three floating top groups with live agent status, tabbed left panel, vertical tool rail, frames with agent cursor and write state, tabbed right panel with activity feed and a note field for the agent. Source: app replica on https://doop.design/ and https://doop.design/docs; the app itself (/c/...) needs a login.
3. `3-stage` — screen alone on a stage, all tools in a command palette.
4. `4-dock` — one rounded tool dock, one sheet at a time, pin to keep open; variants as chips, comments as pins.
5. `5-review` — Review changes mode: changed region outlined, list of agent writes, timeline.

**UX Design recommendation:** 4 as the base. From 2 take the live agent status pill and the Activity tab; the palette from 3 as a keyboard layer; 5 as a later mode. Status: proposal, not reviewed or approved.

### Decision and refinement (2026-11-26)

Christian chose **Stitch** (1-stitch). Dock, Doop, Stage and Review are not pursued for now. Refined in mockup `ui-refresh-stitch` (variants `base`, `mockups-tab`; PNGs in `mockups/ui-refresh-stitch/renders/`):
- The canvas shows exactly one screen, the open one (110%, about 970 x 620 px at 1440 x 900).
- One left card with a segmented control **Screens | Mockups** (counts in the segments, find field below); the separate Mockups card is gone.
- A floating **vertical tool bar** between the card and the screen, top-aligned with the frame: Comment, Variants (count badge), Inspect, Preview, separator, More. Icons with short labels; `role="toolbar"`, `aria-orientation="vertical"`, tooltips open to the right.
- The toolbar above the frame is removed.
- Unchanged from 1-stitch: floating top groups (brand + project, views, Live + Follow agent + settings), right icon rail (notes, comments with badge, flow, design system), zoom pill at the bottom.
Status: proposal, not reviewed or approved.

### Round 2 (2026-11-26, from Christian's 7 comments)

New variants `base-v2` and `mockups-tab-v2` (PNGs `renders/base-v2.png`, `renders/mockups-tab-v2.png`); `base` and `mockups-tab` stay unchanged so the comment threads keep their anchors.
- **Agent bar** replaces the right icon rail: a slim floating card (248 px, full height, grip + fold) with the live status on top ("Writing checkout" plus detail) and a **Follow the agent** switch, the **Activity** feed below (writes, reads, comments, newest first), a **note field for the agent** at the bottom, scoped to the open screen and variant. Interpretation of "agent bar" by cto/ux, modelled on the Activity panel of `2-doop`; to be confirmed. Live and Follow left the top-right group, which now only holds settings.
- **Tool bar**: grip and fold control in its header (shown expanded). Order: Comment, Inspect | Notes, Comments (open-count badge), Flow, Design system | More. Preview (does not exist) and Variants (now in the screen tree) are removed.
- **Screens card** runs from its top down to the zoom pill's bottom edge (same bottom line, 18 px from the window edge) and scrolls inside, with a fade at the bottom.
- **Screen rows** keep the desktop/mobile icon, show their tags as compact chips (overflow as "+N") and a variant count; variants are a collapsible tree (`role="tree"`, `aria-expanded`) under the screen. `home` is expanded with default (selected), empty, error, loading; the others are collapsed; screens without variants have no chevron.
- **Mockups tab** mirrors this: tags, counts and a collapsible variant tree (`onboarding-ideas` expanded). Mockups keep the stacked-layers icon because they declare no viewport.
- To make room for the Agent bar the open screen shows at 90% (about 790 x 505 px at 1440 x 900), centred between tool bar and Agent bar; the zoom pill is centred on that area.
Status: proposal, not reviewed or approved.

### Round 3 (2026-11-26, from Christian's 7 comments on the round 2 variants)

`base-v2` and `mockups-tab-v2` were edited in place (Christian's instruction); new variant `board` (PNGs `renders/base-v2.png`, `renders/mockups-tab-v2.png`, `renders/board.png`).
- **Icon-only tool bar** (52 px wide, 40 px buttons, same ids on every tab). No visible labels; each button has an `aria-label` and a `popover="hint"` tooltip wired with `interestfor`, which opens after the pointer rests on the tool for about **2 s** (`interest-delay-start: 2s`); the tooltip opens to the right (`position-area: inline-end`) and shows name and shortcut. Shown as a state example on Inspect in `base-v2`. The toolbar is `focusgroup="toolbar wrap block"` (arrow keys move between tools).
- **Unavailable tools are greyed out**, not hidden: `aria-disabled="true"`, light grey icon, still focusable, label names why ("not available for mockups"). Mockups tab: only Comment and Comments are enabled. Board: Comment, Comments, Flow (flow arrows on/off, shown pressed) and More (clusters on/off, collapse all) are enabled; Inspect, Notes and Design system are greyed.
- **Variant rows** in the screen tree use the desktop/mobile icon of their viewport instead of a dot and show their own tags (compact chips, "+N"). Mockup variant rows use the mockup (stacked layers) icon and show no tags, because mockup variants have none.
- **Tag toggle**: a square icon button right of the find field (`aria-pressed`, label "Show tags", stays the same in both states) shows or hides all tag chips in the list. Shown on; same control on the Mockups tab and the Board.
- **Mockups canvas shows several mockup variants side by side**: the variants of the expanded mockup as frames in a row, scaled to fit (60% for three 390 px frames). Each frame label is mockup icon + "mockup title: variant title" (e.g. "Onboarding ideas: Guided tour"). The selected variant has a teal ring and is highlighted in the list tree.
- **Board** (new variant `board`): same chrome, Board tab active. The left card stays on the Board because it carries the board filter (one filter shared with the screen list, decision `chr621-filter-lives-in-sidebar`) and the pins: find field with the filter ("checkout"), a status line ("5 on the board", Clear pins), the list grouped into Matches and Pinned, a pin button per row (filled = pinned). It folds like on the other tabs when more canvas is needed. The canvas shows each screen as a cluster: label (viewport icon, name, variant count, pin mark when pinned), the main frame, and micro thumbnails for its variants (selected = teal). Matches have a solid outline; screens pinned outside the filter a dashed teal outline. Flow arrows connect frames where a flow exists (cart → checkout → order-placed). The screen the agent is writing carries a violet ring and a "Writing" chip, matching the Agent bar. All frames share one zoom (24%), the zoom pill offers − / + and Fit all. The tool bar is top-aligned with the cards because the Board has no single frame to align with.
Status: proposal, not reviewed or approved.

### Phase 1 in the real screens (2026-11-27)

Christian approved the direction (`base-v2` = Screens view, `board` = Board view, `mockups-tab-v2` = Mockups tab) and asked for the real screens of this project to be redesigned. Scope: Screens view and Board view only; Design System view and Use Cases are out of scope and untouched. Phase 1 = tokens, components and the two anchor screens; decision `chr1257-stitch-chrome`.
- **Tokens (additive only):** themed `workspace`, `workspace-dot`, `float`, `cluster`, `shadow-card`, `shadow-frame`, `shadow-raised`, `hint`, `hint-text`, `agent`, `agent-subtle` in `chrome-light` and `chrome-dark`; `radius.card/item/frame/inset`; `size.tool/toolbar/float-control/field-lg/tag/nav-card/agent-bar/dot-grid`.
- **New components:** `float-pill`, `float-btn`, `float-icon-btn`, `float-card`, `seg-tabs`, `find-field`, `tag-toggle`, `tree-row`, `tree-variant-row`, `tool-bar`, `tool-btn`, `tool-sep`, `hint-tooltip`, `agent-status`, `agent-activity`, `agent-note`, `section-head`, `zoom-pill`, `frame-label`, `pin-toggle`, `board-cluster`, `cluster-thumb` (see each `usage`). The CHR-905 components stay unchanged because out-of-scope screens use them.
- **`app-shell`** redrawn after `base-v2`; **`board-view`** redrawn after `board`. Node ids kept where the element survived (`project-picker`, `tab-*`, `settings-button`, `left-header`, `filter`, `screens-list`, `comments-header`, `toolbar-side-*`, `agent-*`, `bc-*`, `si-*`, `screen-filter`, `clear-pins-btn`); flows kept for the surviving controls. Context and Elements panels are gone (Notes and Comments open from the tool bar).
- **Phase 2 (open):** dark variants (`chrome-c-shell-dark`, `board-view-dark`), the Mockups tab, the remaining Screens and Board states (inspector, comments panel, follow, variant tree, collapsed, empty, board clusters, zoomed, presented).
Status: phase 1 drawn, awaiting Christian's approval.

### Phase 2a in the real screens (2026-11-27)

Christian's calls for this phase: the zoom pill stays slim and clicking the % value opens a popover with a continuous 5–200 % slider (`zoom-pill` variant `slider-open`, decision `chr621-continuous-zoom-slider` updated); the teal accent-subtle tree selection stays (decision `chr1257-tree-selection-teal`, supersedes `chr905-c-rollout-details` for the tree); overlays and project-start screens are phase 2b.

- **Screens view states** redrawn in the Stitch chrome: `chrome-c-shell-dark`, `chrome-c-shell-menu` (project menu as `float-popover`), `chrome-c-shell-zoom-menu` (slider popover), `chrome-c-shell-offline` (`live-chip` offline in the Agent bar), `chrome-c-shell-shortcuts` (native `<dialog>`, `shortcut-row` + `kbd-key`), `chrome-c-compare` (compare pill, diff outlines, Differences panel with `diff-row`), `chrome-c-mockup-columns` (Mockups tab, three columns), `comments-panel`, `inspector-selected`, `inspector-variant-reached-from`, `sidebar-variant-tree`, `sidebars-collapsed`, `screen-view-variant-breadcrumb` (+ dark), `shell-empty-project` (+ dark, `get-started-card`), `shell-topbar-beta-badge`.
- **Follow states:** `follow-active-feed` (+ dark), `follow-feed-empty`, `follow-highlight-dark`, `follow-mockup-cue`, `follow-paused-node-highlights`. Follow and Activity now live in the Agent bar (`agent-status` variants `follow-paused`, `idle`; `agent-activity` variants `error`, `deleted`; `write-badge`).
- **Board states:** `board-view-dark`, `board-view-empty`, `board-view-presented`, `board-view-zoomed-in` (200 %, slider open), `board-view-zoomed-out` (186 tiles at an honest 8 %), `board-view-clusters-collapsed`, `board-view-clusters-expanded` (+ dark) with `board-cluster-expanded`, `cluster-member`, `cluster-toggle`.
- **Conventions:** tool panels (Comments, Inspect, Compare) open in the right column and fold the Agent bar above them (decision `chr1257-tool-panels-fold-agent-bar`); example user content lives in `stand-in-*` components (decision `chr1257-stand-in-components`). The Board's flow-arrows toggle uses key E everywhere (F stays the Flow tool in the Screens view); `board-view` was patched to match.
- **New components:** `canvas-frame`, `stand-in-orders`, `stand-in-screen-tree`, `stand-in-board`, `view-bar`, `live-chip`, `agent-bar-folded`, `comment-pin`, `comment-entry`, `comment-summary`, `inspect-outline`, `prop-row`, `node-row`, `info-card`, `crumb`, `float-popover`, `float-menu-item`, `kbd-key`, `shortcut-row`, `step-number`, `get-started-card`, `diff-row`, `write-badge`, `board-cluster-expanded`, `cluster-member`, `cluster-toggle`. New variants on phase-1 components: `zoom-pill` `slider-open`, `float-btn` `hover`, `agent-status` `follow-paused` / `idle`, `agent-activity` `error` / `deleted`. One phase-1 token changed: `chrome-dark.float` (more opaque, only CHR-1257 dark screens use it).
- **Checks:** every changed screen screenshotted, no red outlines; flows 347 edges, 0 dangling; use-case warnings 0 on the cases that map these screens (texts of `follow-agent-live`, `inspect-node` and `comment-on-node` updated).
- **Phase 2b (open):** settings menu, update notice, what's new, MCP setup, `chrome-c-dialog*`, no-project, open-project and init-project screens.
Status: phase 2a drawn, awaiting Christian's approval.

### Phase 2b in the real screens (2026-11-27)

Overlays and project start in the Stitch chrome; decision `chr1257-dialog-surface-float`.

- **Dialog shell** (pattern `float-dialog`): native `<dialog>` with `aria-labelledby`, `closedby="any"`, `autofocus` on the primary action or first field; surface `--chrome-float` + blur, `radius.card`, h1 title + one-line sub, h2 group headings in sentence case, lists and long text in `--chrome-field` trays. Close, Cancel and a scrim click return to the screen underneath (flows). Float instead of raised because dark raised and field are nearly the same colour and hid the trays.
- **Overlays:** `shell-settings-menu` (+ dark) as `float-popover` (`popover="auto"`, `focusgroup="menu"`) off the settings button; the Variant map toggle is gone because the variant bar it switched no longer exists. `shell-update-notice` as `popover="manual"` toast in a "Notifications" region. `shell-whats-new`. `shell-mcp-setup-dialog` with `status-row`s (Claude Code expanded with its command, Cursor expandable but collapsed). `shell-mcp-setup-dialog-skill` (+ dark), `-skill-all-installed` (+ dark, footer with check icon), `-skill-reader` (+ dark, 600 px wide), `-skill-status-unavailable` (+ dark, info note). All over `app-shell` (dark: `chrome-c-shell-dark`).
- **`chrome-c-dialog` (+ dark)** redrawn as the equivalent, not obsolete: it is the New project dialog opened inside a project (over `app-shell` / `chrome-c-shell-dark`), the in-project counterpart of `init-project-dialog`.
- **No project open** (`no-project-empty-state` + dark): only the logo + "No project" picker and the settings button stay as float pills; view tabs, left card, tool bar, Agent bar and zoom pill are hidden because each needs a project. A centred float card offers Open project (primary, autofocus) and New project, the AI prompt in a `code-field`, and recent projects.
- **Open project** (`open-project-dialog`, `open-project-dialog-new-folder`, `open-project-dialog-new-folder-exists`, `open-project-dialog-new-folder-created`) and **New project** (`init-project-dialog`, `init-project-dialog-new-folder`, `init-project-dialog-new-folder-created`, `init-project-dialog-new-folder-exists`, `init-project-dialog-new-folder-invalid`, `init-project-dialog-new-folder-permission`) over `no-project-empty-state`: quick chips (`aria-pressed` in a "Places" group), folder breadcrumbs (`nav` + `ol`, `aria-current="location"`), folder list as `role=listbox`, the new-folder row outside the listbox, errors with `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby`, hint lines `aria-live="polite"`. New project uses `text-field` for the project name (`empty` placeholder state, `focus` after the folder was created).
- **New components:** `code-field` (default / compact / block), `status-row` (default / expandable / expanded / muted), `text-field` (default / empty / focus), pattern `float-dialog`. **Restyled in place** (only phase 2b screens use them): `btn` (+ `ghost`), `quick-chip`, `new-folder-btn`, `new-folder-row`, `chrome-list-row` (+ `new`), `chrome-segmented`, `chrome-toggle-row`, `chrome-menu-item-detail`. No token added or changed.
- **Flows:** `app-shell.settings-button` → `shell-settings-menu` added; close, cancel and scrim edges on every dialog.
- **Checks:** every changed screen screenshotted, no red outlines; flows 420 edges, 0 dangling; use-case warnings 0 (`create-project`, `open-existing-project`, `change-preferences`, `update-artisign`, `switch-project`, `connect-ai-tools`).
Status: phase 2b drawn, awaiting Christian's approval.
